estimates.basis: Frozen C17 HLS resource/cycle measurements. Full-image C validation preserves arithmetic; RTL includes finite-FIFO/AXI behavior. Physical resources and timing remain unknown until routed reports. No board measurement is inferred. Decision basis: C17 passes all 13 E065-exact course images with mean deltaPSNR -0.07589037644656216 dB and border MSE 1.405191888267716e-05; all three MAC folds have actual II=1. Its HLS counts are 1032 DSP, 127985 LUT, 192308 FF and 146 BRAM18K, within the approved physical-verification screen while preserving the original HLS infeasible status. C14 measured 300632 cycles with a two-entry window FIFO; C17 changes only depth to32 and predicted 272000 cycles before implementation. Validate both exact changed-parameter transactions and finite-FIFO counters, allow faster execution without a lower cycle bound, and judge acceleration using independently closed routing. Run with one heavy task plus budgeted light work and retain the six-hour timeout.
